empty_completion_fence.semantics: GPU-0 same-clock empty interval after untimed NCCL start alignment through completion of one NCCL reduce

execution.combine: DeepEP Buffer.combine with Buffer.capture previous_event and completion_event.current_stream_wait
execution.runner: SGLang DeepGemmRunnerCore contiguous FP8 grouped GEMM

measurement.completion_fenced_timing: GPU-0 same-clock interval after untimed NCCL start alignment through an NCCL end reduce enqueued after local completion
measurement.t_proxy: max rank-local block elapsed; not a calibrated global makespan

tolerance.policy: Identity replay was bitwise equal to the captured output. Across all 12 frozen swaps and eight ranks, the correctness-only pilot maximum absolute error was 2^-9 with no NaN/Inf. Freeze an absolute tolerance of 2^-8 (two times the observed maximum); use rtol=0 because relative error is unstable near zero.
